profile.name: 台式数字万用表
profile.description: 这是一款安捷伦 34410A 系列 6.5 位台式数字万用表，用于实验室中的高精度电学测量，如电压、电流、电阻等参数测试。该类仪器常用于台架测试、自动化测量以及带内部读数存储的采样记录场景。
profile.description_en: This is an Agilent 34410A-series 6.5-digit bench digital multimeter used for precise electrical measurements in laboratories, such as voltage, current, and resistance. Instruments in this class are commonly used for bench testing, automated measurement setups, and buffered data acquisition with internal reading memory.

registry.name: Agilent Technologies AGILENT34410A
registry.description: Agilent34410a是由Agilent Technologies (Keysight)生产的表征设备，主要功能包括中止、初始化、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, clear memory等操作。
